incidentDetails: During test Suite A implementation, prepareManualPayload was run against canonical review-execution root instead of an isolated fixture, creating review-execution/scale500-tmdb-18912 directory structure. No model calls or human adjudications occurred.
remediation: Canonical Candidate #2 directory removed before post-pilot authorization freeze. Suite A updated to use isolated temporary root.
futurePrevention: production-equivalent tests must use isolated temporary roots and must never create canonical future-candidate state
